prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic photograph of an adult woman working as a hospital nurse; use the attached reference image for her face only, closely preserving her pale-blonde hair, soft oval features, wide gray-brown eyes, straight brows, small nose, and glossy rose lips. In an after-hours treatment room, present her as obsessively affectionate yet unnervingly possessive, holding a capped medical syringe beside her cheek without touching anyone. Frame a vertical medium close-up from mid-torso, keeping her face and the clearly visible capped syringe in the same crisp focal plane. Her gentle bedside smile and unwavering eye contact suggest tender devotion slipping into controlled menace. Cool fluorescent light wraps naturally across her face while a faint red monitor glow traces the room behind her; use natural skin texture and shallow depth of field. She wears a clean, fully opaque white nurse uniform. No injection, blood, wound, injury, text, logo, or watermark.
